{{Quote|G-good shootin', hotshot...! He only got my shoulder--but from the way I f-feel... that point may have been dipped in sand bat venom.|Biggs Darklighter|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 17">[[Star Wars (1977) 17|''Star Wars'' (1977) 17]]</ref>}}
'''Sand bat venom''' was a substance that was extracted from the [[Sand bat/Legends|sand bat]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] coated their [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]] sticks with this substance to make them more effective.
